high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the website "Business Today," as indicated by the logo at the top. The article discusses successful models of non-profit, high-quality, and cost-effective healthcare services in India, mentioning institutions such as Tata Memorial, AIIMS (All India Institute of Medical Sciences), Dayanand Medical College & Hospital, P.D. Hinduja Charitable Hospital, and PGI Chandigarh. These institutions are highlighted for their investment in cutting-edge technology to benefit underprivileged populations and set benchmarks for excellence in healthcare.
